views.note: The user runs intro/open/links/version; every command resolves through the profile package.

views.label: Site link path

views.label: Install path

cards.title: CLI
items: Go 1.22 module github.com/entelecheia/entelecheia with main.go dispatching through internal/profile
Four commands: intro (ASCII banner), open [alias], links (alias table), version
Color output adapts via profile.SupportsColor; unknown aliases list available ones

cards.title: Link registry
items: 11 site aliases in internal/profile/profile.go: home, cv, halla, koica-tiu, rise, staix/bwlb, research, repos, github, linkedin
open defaults to home (youngjoon-lee.com); cv resolves to youngjoon-lee.com/cv/
docs/index.html is a static meta-refresh redirect to LinkedIn

cards.title: Identity
items: Profile carries the professor/CAIO identity across halla.ai, jeju.ai, and staixbwlb.com properties
Install via go install github.com/entelecheia/entelecheia@latest or GitHub releases
Tests in internal/profile/profile_test.go and main_test.go cover run paths
